analysis_steps.goal: Image line cubes with JvM correction

findings_qualitative.value: SO traces disk, streamer and outflow out to ~2"

evidence.quote: we see SO emission tracing the disk and for the first time in SO a molecular outflow and the infalling streamer out to $\sim 2"$

claims.hypothesis: Water snowline location in HL Tau
claims.experiment: Resolved 183 GHz imaging, brightness temperature and rotational diagram
claims.result: Steep Tb drop outside central beam; Tex ~350 K
claims.finding: Snowline lies inside ~6 au at probed height

evidence.quote: consistent with the water snowline being located inside the central beam ($\lesssim 6$ au)

claims.hypothesis: Optically thick dust hides IR water
claims.result: 0.02%-2% visible in IR vs 35-70% with ALMA
claims.finding: Dust explains column density offset; lines not strongly masing

evidence.quote: only $0.02\%-2\%$ of the water reservoir is visible at mid- and far-IR wavelengths

claims.hypothesis: H13CO+ anti-correlates with water due to snowline
claims.finding: Likely caused by optically thick dust

evidence.quote: An anti-correlation between the and emission is found but this is likely caused by optically thick dust

why_this_method.value: JvM correction needed to avoid overestimating extended low S/N line fluxes

evidence.quote: this is needed in order not to overestimate line fluxes for extended and low signal-to-noise ratio emission morphologies

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Masing as cause of ALMA vs Herschel column density difference, rejected after dust correction

evidence.quote: the 183, 321, and 325 GHz lines in this work and (cite: Facchini2024) are unlikely to be strongly masing.

limitations_admitted.value: Some SO and H13CO+ flux may be resolved out

evidence.quote: Therefore, some flux might be resolved out.

referee_caveats_inferred: Two-line rotational diagram with LTE and 10% flux error gives weak temperature constraints
Snowline conclusion relies on a simple DALI model not fitted formally
Different ALMA projects and resolutions may introduce flux scale mismatches
